name: $COMMUNITY
description:
Communities are THE most important thing in any coin ever. 

So I'm using that to our advantage and launching $COMMUNITY. 

The thesis is simple. Everytime someone joins the community, a coin with their name will be deployed on new pairs on a fresh dev wallet. 

This helps advertise our coin, as well as show off the people who are in the community. 

Furthermore, I have paid a team of HUGE bagworkers, and will keep paying them with creator rewards to make this one of the biggest communities the trenches have ever seen.

I want this coin to have the largest, most active and most bullish community members in the ENTIRE trenches.

Additionally, I'll be doing a bunch of giveaways in the community so we can get it active and grow it further.

Ofc I'll be going LIVE on this, paying DEX, DEX boosts etc. To try get our name out there even more.
